p0.finding: The canonical run and EXIT trap are created before any point resource gate. A preflight-only failure leaves the canonical path occupied although the attempt marker and DC launch never occurred.
p0.contract_conflict: preflight failure before first DC launch consumes attempt = false
p0.required_repair: Keep the canonical run absent through K1 preflight; use a staging preflight area and atomically publish/create canonical run only at the first launch boundary.

p0.finding: Exact inputs and runner are recorded before K1 but are not rechecked before K8/K1x8 or at final sealing.
p0.impact: Shared-workspace drift can make the three supposedly matched points use different RTL/TCL/libraries while retaining the initial identity ledger.
p0.required_repair: Recheck the full exact-SHA set plus absolute runner before each point and after K1x8; final-verify the initial identity manifest.

p0.finding: Runtime resource_snapshot failures are ignored, and no post-final-point cgroup gate precedes PASS sealing.
p0.impact: A failcnt/under_oom/oom_kill violation during K1x8 can still yield a final PASS despite the contract's any-OOM fail rule.
p0.required_repair: Latch cgroup OOM violations across each runtime monitor and require no violation after every point and before root PASS sealing.

p1.finding: A foreign sleeping process can wake after the final sample or during DC; sampled qualification is not an exclusive resource reservation.
p1.required_disclosure: Describe the policy as sampled coexistence and do not claim concurrency was impossible.

p1.finding: ps pcpu is lifetime-average CPU, not interval utilization.
p1.required_disclosure: Freeze this metric definition; optionally add interval CPU deltas for stronger classification.

p1.finding: The vcs matcher covers normal vcs executable forms but not every possible VCS-family helper name.
p1.recommended_repair: Add explicit exact-command checks for the VCS-family helpers intended by the forever-forbidden policy.
